reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and the shared getDateWithWeekendRule like getUpcomingDates does; only the daily-weekend skip is written inline because no helper for it exists.

duplication.why: The daily skip condition (`isDaily && skipWeekend && isWeekend`) mirrors the inline check in shared getNextDate, and the RSchedule setup mirrors getUpcomingDates, but both are short.

placement.why: Added next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and registered as a handler the same way.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its type registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Compact and readable; the ±3 day widening is an unexplained magic number and the daily-skip rule now lives in two places.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily-weekend skip condition is restated plainly, not disguised.
